reviewItem.question: Does "Istio CRDs are templated by default and can be installed and upgraded via `helm install istio-base`: This changes how CRDs are upgraded" mean a change to migration:istio|name=crd-helm-templating (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: Istio CRDs are now templated by default and managed via Helm; the recommended upgrade method changes from kubectl apply to helm upgrade istio-base, and CRD labels are updated to match Helm-installed resources.
